items.description: A named deterministic device whose lifetime is independent of its output consumers.

name.description: The instance identity used by displays, controls, and hardware operations.

configuration.description: The provider's versioned configuration, validated through its descriptor.
configuration.$comment: Open payload: this member's shape is decided by an id named elsewhere in the document, never by this generator.

running.description: Whether the host advances this instance. A stopped instance retains its hardware state.

memory.description: Ordered hardware bindings, independent of any display.

items.description: An ordered scalar binding between a named device and an Int world-state cell.

name.description: The binding identity within its machine.

direction.description: Whether values enter or leave world state.
direction.title: WorldMachineMemoryDirection

format.description: The signed or unsigned scalar format: i8/u8, i16/u16, i32/u32, or i64/u64.

address.description: An unsigned raw address; mutually exclusive with Symbol.

symbol.description: An exported content symbol; mutually exclusive with Address.

key.description: The key of a table-shaped state row, or null for a slot.

access.description: inspect for reads; patch or bus for writes.

update.description: onChange or everyTick. Repeating a hardware-visible write requires explicit everyTick authoring.

conversion.description: checked by default; truncate explicitly admits narrowing and bit reinterpretation.

items.title: WorldMachineMemory

cable.description: The optional standing cable endpoint owned by this machine instance.

name.description: The cable's stable kebab-case name, shared by every plugged port.

position.description: This machine's 0-based place in cable order — contiguous across the cable's ports (validated), and what decides the linking engine's deterministic player order.
